name: Minimum Binder Content (minBinderContentKgM3)
description: The minimum binder threshold for concrete designs (250 kg/m³) is defined in both the central knowledge limits and the constants.ts file, creating a redundant declaration.

name: Absolute Volume Tolerance (absoluteVolumeToleranceL)
description: The absolute volume tolerance (10 liters) is defined in validationLimits and replicated as ABSOLUTE_VOLUME_TOLERANCE_L in constants.ts.

name: Maximum Superplasticizer Dosage (maxSuperplasticizerDosagePercent)
description: The limit for superplasticizer dosage (5%) is defined in validationLimits and duplicated in constants.ts.

name: Geopolymer Concrete (GPC) Validation Logic
description: The rule prohibiting Portland cement and requiring SCMs (Fly Ash/Slag) with chemical activators is defined as static data in dreuxKnowledgeBase.ts, duplicated as a schema validator in concreteTypes.ts, and fully implemented as imperative code checks in suitabilityGate.ts.

name: High Strength Concrete (HSC) Validation Logic
description: Rules requiring cement class >= 52.5, superplasticizers, and silica fume are duplicated across the knowledge base, concrete type configs, and the suitability gate check.

name: Self-Consolidating Concrete (SCC) Validation Logic
description: Limiting aggregate diameter (Dmax <= 16mm), requiring superplasticizers, limestone filler, and viscosity modifying agents (VMA) is validated in three separate files.

name: Fiber-Reinforced Concrete (FRC) Validation Logic
description: Checking for fiber selection and non-zero dosage is defined in the categories knowledge rules, concrete type configs, and suitabilityGate.ts.

name: Lightweight and Heavyweight Concrete Density Limits
description: Validating aggregate density (<2000 kg/m³ for lightweight and >3000 kg/m³ for heavyweight) is duplicated across the category parameters, type metadata, and suitability checks.

name: Roller-Compacted Concrete (RCC) Slump Check
description: RCC zero-slump limit (<= 2 cm) is defined inside the concreteCategories validationRules and also replicated in suitabilityGate.ts.

name: Shotcrete Max Aggregate Size (Dmax) Check
description: The maximum aggregate diameter check (Dmax <= 16mm) to prevent hose blocking is defined as a validation rule in the knowledge base, type configs, and suitability gate.
